navigation.type: bottom tab bar (mobile-first) + top header bar
navigation.mobile_behavior: Bottom tab bar collapses to hamburger on desktop sidebar

wireframes.layout: Top header with app name and avatar. Main scrollable content area.
sections: Top: Safety Score card (large number 0-100 with color: green >70, yellow 40-70, red <40 + trend arrow)
Row of 3 mini stat cards: Total Trips | SOS Alerts | Zone Alerts
Active trip card (if any trip in progress): shows current location on mini map + 'End Trip' button
Recent activity feed: list of last 10 events (trips completed, SOS triggered, alerts received) with icons and timestamps
Quick action FAB (floating button): SOS button always visible at bottom-right

wireframes.layout: Full-page centered layout with a large prominent button
sections: Large red SOS button in center (fills most of the viewport, pulsing animation)
Below button: current location preview (text: lat/lng + 'Tap to confirm location')
Below: list of emergency contacts that will be notified (name + relationship + phone)
Optional message text input: 'Add a voice note or message'
Safety tip: 'Only tap SOS in a real emergency. Contacts will receive your live location.'
Cancel/Back button at top-left

wireframes.layout: Map takes full viewport. Overlay panels at bottom.
sections: Full-screen Leaflet/Mapbox map showing current location marker and route path
Bottom sheet (draggable): shows trip status — Safe Zone ✅ / Caution ⚠️ / Unsafe 🚨 with color indicator
Start Trip form (when no active trip): 'Enter destination' text input + 'Start Tracking' button
Active trip overlay: elapsed time, distance covered, safe zone status badge
'End Trip' button (red, prominent) when trip is active
Alert popup when entering unsafe zone: full-screen warning with 'I'm Safe' acknowledge button

wireframes.layout: List page with add button in header
sections: Header with 'Add Contact' button (plus icon)
Contact list: each shows avatar circle (first letter), name, phone, relationship badge, swipe-to-delete
Add/Edit modal: form with fields [Name*, Phone*, Email, Relationship] + Save/Cancel buttons
Empty state: 'No emergency contacts yet. Add at least one to use SOS.' with illustration
Footer note: 'These contacts will be notified when you trigger SOS'
Two tabs at top: 'Trips' and 'SOS Alerts'
Trips tab: list of past trips with date, start/end locations, duration, safe zone alerts count. Tap to expand map view.
SOS Alerts tab: list of past SOS triggers with timestamp, location (lat/lng), number of contacts notified, status (resolved/pending)
Each item shows a small map thumbnail, date badge, and key stats

wireframes.layout: Centered card on a gradient background
sections: App logo + name 'SafeRoam' at top
Tagline: 'Your safety companion for Delhi'
Form fields with labels and validation errors inline
Submit button (full width, primary color)
Link to switch between Login / Register
'Forgot password?' link on login page

wireframes.layout: Simple list page with grouped sections
sections: Profile section: Name, Email, Phone (editable fields)
Preferences: Safe zone alert radius slider, Auto-start tracking on app open toggle, Notification preferences
About: App version, Privacy Policy link, Terms of Service
Logout button (red, at bottom)
